description: Get vault status including initialized state, lock state, and backend info.
embedding_description: Vault: status. Reports initialized (setup complete), unlocked (ready to read/write secrets), backend (which vault plugin is bound — default file vault, AWS Secrets Manager, etc.), recovery_key_exists (backup master key minted). Use to confirm the vault is ready before store / retrieve / rotate / delete operations.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Vault operational status. Contains initialized (setup complete), unlocked (ready for operations), backend (storage type), and recovery_key_exists (backup available).
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Determine the appropriate next action based on the context and action result.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Retrieves vault operational status. Does not require unlocking - reads metadata only.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: StorageError: Unable to read vault configuration. ConfigurationError: Vault configuration is corrupted.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For StorageError: Check file system permissions and disk space. For ConfigurationError: May need to reinitialize vault (data loss warning).
